verdict.rationale: DGX B200 docs show it can be operated headlessly via CLI tools (nvidia-smi, health check commands), containerized workloads via Docker Engine/NVIDIA Container Toolkit, and remote out-of-band management via Redfish, IPMI, SNMP, and KVM interfaces — all consistent with running in automated/CI pipelines without a GUI. However there is no explicit mention of CI/CD integration, scripting APIs, or automation framework examples (e.g., Jenkins/GitHub Actions hooks) in the evidence pack. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline integration examples, documented automation APIs beyond nvidia-smi/CLI, and independent hands-on confirmation of headless automated workflows.
